# `browser-tab window open`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab window open [FLAGS] <url>…`

Open a new window with one or more URLs

## Arguments

### `<url>…`

## Flags

### `--browser <name>`

chrome|chromium|brave|edge|safari

### `--bounds <bounds>`

Global-coordinate frame x,y,w,h

### `--display <n>`

0-based display index (fills that monitor)

### `--state <state>`

normal|minimized|maximized|fullscreen

### `--incognito`

Open a private/incognito window

### `--no-focus`

Open in the background
